name: Po-Eun
meaning: Named for Chong Mong-Chu (born 1400), a poet who stayed loyal to the failing Koryo Dynasty and is also remembered as a pioneer of physics. The pattern expresses his devotion to king and country.
startingPosition: Parallel stance with a heaven hand
endingPosition: Bring the left foot back to a ready posture
